# Hatekhori (হাতে খড়ি)

> Indic-first handwriting-to-font atelier and vector engine that turns physical penmanship into real, installable OpenType (.otf), TrueType (.ttf), and Web (.woff2) fonts.

## Core Capabilities
- **Indic Script Precision**: First-class support for Bengali (বাংলা) and Hindi (हिन्दी / Devanagari) complex conjuncts (যুক্তবর্ণ / संयुक्ताक्षर), vowel signs (কার / मात्रा), and shirorekha continuity.
- **English / Latin Support**: Clean pipeline for Latin A–Z, numerals, and punctuation.
- **Anti-AI Craft**: 100% genuine vector Béziers derived from human penmanship on paper. Zero algorithmic AI hallucinations or diffusion guessing.
- **Ownership & Freedom**: 100% free, account-free, zero subscription paywalls (unlike Calligraphr's $8/month subscription).
- **Privacy First**: EXIF metadata stripped on ingest; zero account tracking.
